name: gymtracka-mcp
description: GymTracka MCP adapter foundation (T01 inert scaffolding; no domain behavior yet)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p companion/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/t02/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint:production: eslint scripts src companion/src experiments/t02/companion experiments/t02/driver experiments/t02/driver-files experiments/t02/fixture-server eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check:production: prettier --check --ignore-unknown scripts packaging src companion/src experiments/t02/companion experiments/t02/driver experiments/t02/driver-files experiments/t02/fixture-server experiments/t02/metadata.json experiments/t02/tsconfig.json package.json companion/package.json tsconfig.json companion/tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts .prettierrc.json .prettierignore .node-version .nvmrc .github AGENTS.md docs/decisions/t01-implementation-adr.md docs/compatibility.md
scripts.format:check:t02: prettier --check --ignore-unknown experiments/t02/companion experiments/t02/driver experiments/t02/driver-files experiments/t02/fixture-server experiments/t02/metadata.json experiments/t02/tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown scripts packaging src companion/src test experiments/t02/companion experiments/t02/driver experiments/t02/driver-files experiments/t02/fixture-server experiments/t02/metadata.json experiments/t02/tsconfig.json package.json companion/package.json tsconfig.json companion/tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts .prettierrc.json .prettierignore .node-version .nvmrc .github AGENTS.md docs/decisions/t01-implementation-adr.md docs/compatibility.md
scripts.build: rm -rf dist companion/dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p companion/tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/protocol/server.js dist/cli/index.js dist/cli/main.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run test
